Zona pedonale: Qui sotto non si arriva in auto. Vi consigliamo di viaggiare in treno (la stazione è a pochi minuti a piedi) oppure di lasciare la macchina nei parcheggi subito fuori dal centro storico. Da qui in poi, vi muoverete benissimo a piedi.

Welcome to Casa Nemo! If you are looking for a practical home base to experience Finale Ligure and completely forget about your car, you are in the right place. Inside the apartment The apartment can comfortably host up to 4 people. As soon as you walk in, you enter the living area: on the left is the equipped kitchen, and right in front of you is a French double sofa bed. Past a small hallway, you'll find the bathroom (with a shower) and finally the bedroom. It’s a well-organized and functional space, perfect if you plan to spend most of your days at the beach or exploring the town.

Good to know before you book We want to be completely transparent about a couple of practical details. These are part of the charm (and the slight compromise) of staying in a true historical Ligurian building:
The stairs: Like almost all period buildings in the area, there is no elevator. You will have to climb some stairs to reach the apartment, so keep that in mind when packing your bags!

Pedestrian zone: You cannot drive right up to the front door. We highly recommend traveling by train (the station is just a few minutes' walk away) or leaving your car in the public parking lots just outside the historical center. Once you are here, you can easily walk everywhere.
